nodes.name: Cathodic electrodeposition of Co1-xFex(OH)2
nodes.procedure: Individual solutions of mixed Co(NO3)2 and FeCl2 (total 0.1 M metal ion concentration) for Co1-xFex(OH)2 films of x > 0 and 0.1 M FeCl2 and 0.05 M NaNO3 for x = 1 were freshly prepared in 18.2 MΩ·cm water. All solutions containing FeCl2 were covered in Parafilm and purged with N2 for ~20 min prior to FeCl2 addition and between depositions. Co1-xFex(OH)2 was cathodically deposited onto Au/Ti-coated 5 MHz QCM crystals (previously cleaned in 1 M H2SO4 via potential cycling and checked in 1 M KOH) using a two-electrode cell with a carbon-cloth counter electrode. Deposition was accomplished by applying between -0.1 and -4.0 mA cm^-2 (cathodic) until the desired mass (~10 μg cm^-2) was registered on the QCM.

nodes.name: Co(OH)2 precipitation for KOH purification
nodes.procedure: Co(OH)2 was precipitated from Co(NO3)2 (0.5-1 g, 99.999% trace metal basis) with ~0.1 M KOH and washed three times via mechanical agitation, centrifugation, and decanting. The triple-washed Co(OH)2 was then added to the 1 M KOH electrolyte and mechanically agitated for 10 min to absorb Fe impurities. The resultant brown suspension was centrifuged for 1 h and the Fe-free electrolyte decanted.

nodes.characterization_summary: SEM shows as-deposited films consist of ~100 nm diameter vertically oriented platelets; morphology unchanged by Fe addition; after 2h OER at 350 mV: x=0 less defined, x=0.54 unaffected, x=1 dissolved revealing Au substrate.
nodes.evidence_snippet: SEM imaging shows that the as-deposited films consist of platelets roughly 100 nm in diameter that tend to be vertically oriented ... The scale bars are 100 nm.

properties.description: Morphology images showing nanostructured surfaces with varying Fe content

nodes.characterization_summary: XPS O 1s spectra show as-deposited CoOOH single peak 531.5-530.0 eV indicating hydroxide environment; mixed films develop oxide-like shoulder at lower binding energy due to Fe3+; post-2h OER increased oxide character; Fe/Co ratio determined; CoOOH acquires 8% Fe from impure electrolyte.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The O 1s XPS spectra of the film as-deposited from pure Co(NO₃)₂ show a single peak in a region between ∼531.5-530.0 eV, indicating the O is in a hydroxide-like environment ... Upon addition of Fe, the O 1s spectra develop a shoulder at lower binding energy indicating O in a more-oxide-like environment.
